heading: Trusted by Security Teams Worldwide
subheading: See how leading engineering and SecOps teams use AEGIX to protect their cloud infrastructure, reduce alert fatigue, and stop threats in real time.

testimonials.quote: AEGIX caught an unpatched API vulnerability within 20 minutes of deployment. It saved our engineering team dozens of hours of manual triage and gave our leadership peace of mind.
testimonials.author: Sarah Lin

testimonials.quote: Before AEGIX, our on-call engineers were drowning in false alarms every weekend. The automated filtering reduced our daily alert volume by over 85% without missing a single real incident.
testimonials.author: Marcus Vance

testimonials.quote: Rolling out across 80 Kubernetes clusters took less than an afternoon. The compliance reports directly streamlined our SOC 2 and ISO 27001 audit workflows.
testimonials.author: Elena Rostova

testimonials.quote: When an unauthorized process attempted lateral movement in our staging environment, AEGIX immediately quarantined the container and notified the on-call channel in Slack.
testimonials.author: David Chen

testimonials.quote: The visibility we gained into east-west network traffic was immediate. We replaced three fragmented legacy monitoring tools with one unified dashboard.
testimonials.author: Julian Thorne

testimonials.quote: Zero performance penalty with under 0.2% CPU overhead. The live dashboard and automated policy enforcement made compliance effortless across our global regions.
testimonials.author: Amina Al-Mansoor

testimonials.quote: AEGIX identified anomalous lateral traversal within a staging cluster and blocked it automatically without breaking active developer deployments.
testimonials.author: Kavita Reddy

testimonials.quote: The automated runtime security guarantees that our customer data stays protected across all regions. It set a new standard for our engineering organization.
testimonials.author: Stefan Lindqvist
